question: The Tungabhadra, the Koyana and the Bhima are major tributaries of which Peninsular river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Krishna River is one of the major rivers in peninsular India.
 
• The Tungabhadra, the Koyana, and the Bhima are significant tributaries of the Krishna River.
 
• The Krishna River flows through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The river originates in the Western Ghats near Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra and flows eastwards into the Bay of Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Godavari River:**

 
 
• The Godavari River is the second longest river in India after the Ganges.
 
• It originates in the Western Ghats in Maharashtra and flows eastwards across the Deccan Plateau to the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Major tributaries of the Godavari include the Purna, Pranhita, Indravati, and Sabari Rivers.
 
 
 
• **Narmada River:**
 
 
• The Narmada River is one of the major rivers in central India, flowing westwards towards the Arabian Sea.
 
• It originates from the Amarkantak Plateau in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Major tributaries include the Burhner, Banjar, and Kolar Rivers.
 
 
 
• **Kaveri River:**
 
 
• The Kaveri River is one of the major rivers in southern India.
 
• It originates in the Western Ghats in Karnataka and flows southeastwards to the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Major tributaries include the Hemavati, Shimsha, and Arkavathi Rivers.
